== Streaming cross-reference ==

=== Build notes ===
* Bill's ruling (11 October 2026): anyone who helps stream gets credit. The wrap-up points to "the secondary stream on Sam Tashima's channel (playlist here)", so [[Sam Tashima]] is now credited here and on his page. The wording follows the source, which does not say who ran or commentated that stream. The playlist URL is on the live page only, not in the preserved text copy, so it is cited in the reference on Sam's page.
* Checked the 2021 Outrider Cup, Outrider Cup III and 2026 San Diego Super Open wrap-ups for similar "stream on someone's channel" mentions: none found.
* "Dan Tartaglione and Garrett Larson ... awesome streaming and commentary coverage" is now on both people's pages, with the text-copy reference. No other stream or commentary credit in this wrap-up.
